ideal: Issues hold bugs and quick fixes: typed, labeled by area, closed within a day, a bug by its pull request. Features wait on the board.

parts.ideal: Only bugs and quick fixes, each typed, labeled by area, shown as a table or image, a bug closed by its pull request
parts.setup: Use the organization's Bug and Task issue types; file with gh issue create and its type flag

parts.ideal: Two valid forms, Bug and Quick fix, and no blank issue
parts.setup: Each form sets its type; config.yml turns blank issues off

parts.ideal: Area labels only; the type says what kind; a label nothing uses is archived
parts.setup: Archive through the labels API or the Labels page; history stays on old issues

parts.ideal: None open, unless a dated goal spans several issues
parts.setup: Give each a due date and close it when done

parts.ideal: Shared, pinned views, each the search behind one metric
parts.setup: Create them in the Issues sidebar; GitHub offers no API for views

parts.ideal: A draft card on the board; an issue only while its pull request is open
parts.setup: Convert the draft and add its area label when the pull request opens
